findings.issue: The `testing` ref is declared and toggled in testRun() (true in try, false in finally) but never consumed in the template — the Test-for-me button is not :disabled by it, so the double-click guard described in the task's Edge cases is not actually wired.
findings.impact: No functional bug — double-click is explicitly optional for AC ('за бажанням', not required). Dead-ish state only.
findings.recommendation: Either bind `:disabled="testing"` on the funnel-test-run button to realize the in-flight guard, or drop the ref. Optional.

findings.issue: testRun() reimplements the inline-vs-toast branch (errorCode + te + t) inline instead of reusing the existing resolveFunnelError() helper. resolveFunnelError already maps a mapped business code to its localized string and falls back to the generic message, but it cannot tell the caller WHICH surface to use (inline vs toast), so a small duplication is justified here.
findings.impact: Minor duplication of the code→i18n lookup logic; both paths stay in sync only by convention.
findings.recommendation: Acceptable as-is. Optionally expose a helper that returns {code, message} so testRun can pick the surface without re-deriving the code. Not required.
